text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: 1821509999 INCIDENT - Token metering anomaly for customer sierra-co (VPC, us-east-1 dedicated pool). Metric divergence: billing_meter.tokens_total vs ingested_tokens ~= +1.22M tokens over last ~2h. Potential billing impact. Paging SRE and Billing.

maya (oncall): ack. I'm on it. @brian can you grab the aggregator logs and confirm whether this is duplication or reingest? lia please notify CSM and create a customer-facing incident note (short). :eyes:

brian (sre): pulling logs now. quick grep shows repeated webhook ack ids for tenant sierra-co, looks like fanout retried twice after a transient error. tail:

```
2027-05-04T14:02:17Z aggregator INFO ingest_event tenant=sierra-co req_id=abcd1234 status=accepted
2027-05-04T14:02:17Z aggregator INFO ingest_event tenant=sierra-co req_id=abcd1234 status=accepted
2027-05-04T14:02:18Z publisher WARN publish_retry req_id=abcd1234 attempt=2
```

brian (sre): seems like the ingress multiplexer didn't dedupe on retry. I'm going to pause the meter republisher for sierra-co and route the tenant to the safe fallback ring.

maya (oncall): do it. Command to pause:

```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.local/tenants/pause-metering -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"sierra-co","reason":"duplicate-ingest-detected"}'
```

ops-eng: starting fallback reroute and capacity check for dedicated pool. Will also scale up a small helper node to run a token reconcile job.

deploy-bot: deploy request accepted. Rolling update to aggregator-service rollback -> image: aggregator:v20270503-7e4d9c started by ops-eng.

maya (oncall): lia — customer note draft: "We detected an internal metering duplicate for your VPC in us-east-1 and are investigating. We have isolated the tenant to prevent further duplication and are working on a reconciliation. No inference data lost; potential billing delta will be reviewed by our billing team. We'll follow up with ETA in 60 min." Send now?

lia (support): sent to CSM and sd@customer.sierra-co: "We are investigating a metering discrepancy impacting your billing metrics. We've isolated the issue and will share a reconciliation plan within 60 minutes." :white_check_mark:

carmen (billing-ops): adding billing_hold flag and starting provisional credit calc. Need exact duplication window and token delta. Can someone export raw token events for tenant sierra-co between 2027-05-04T12:00Z and 2027-05-04T14:30Z and put in s3://redwood-incident-exports/1821509999/sierra-co.tokens.csv ?

brian (sre): exporting now. command:

```
aws s3 cp s3://aggregator-logs/2027/05/04/ingest/*.log - | jq -r 'select(.tenant=="sierra-co") | [.timestamp,.req_id,.event_type,.tokens] | @csv' > /tmp/sierra-co.tokens.csv
aws s3 cp /tmp/sierra-co.tokens.csv s3://redwood-incident-exports/1821509999/sierra-co.tokens.csv
```

brian (sre): export complete. path: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-incident-exports/1821509999/sierra-co.tokens.csv

ops-eng: rollback to aggregator:v20270503-7e4d9c finished. Dedup patch applied to multiplexer config (enable-md5-dedupe=true). Observability shows ingress retries drop to 0 for the tenant after 1821510800.

maya (oncall): confirmed: duplicates stopped at 1821510800. Running quick diff on tokens_total -> duplicated_count ~= 1,220,384 tokens. That matches the prior alert magnitude. :thumbsup:

carmen (billing-ops): got the dump, will calculate provisional credit and open JIRA BILL-4718. Holding invoices for sierra-co for May cycle. Need to confirm whether tokens already invoiced in prior runs — patch window: 2027-05-04T12:05Z -> 2027-05-04T14:11Z (approx). I'll attach the reconcile spreadsheet when done.

maya (oncall): temporary mitigation done. Primary actions: 1) tenant isolated and paused 2) aggregator rolled back 3) dedupe enabled 4) export saved for billing. Next: postmortem + permanent fix + customer communication. Who owns postmortem?

brian (sre): I'll own the postmortem and the fix (longer-term: idempotency token enforced at multiplexer). Will file an RCA and link to this thread.

lia (support): I'll own ongoing customer comms and coordinate with Carmen on credits and final messaging.

maya (oncall): handing off to @brian and @lia for follow-through. I'm out in 25m; @ops-eng you're primary for the next on-call rotation for any followups. Thanks everyone. :v:

carmen (billing-ops): created BILL-4718 and internal ticket INC-1821509999. Adding estimated provisional credit: 1,220,384 tokens -> approx $1,830 provisional (calc attached). Will confirm after final reconciliation.

brian (sre): note for postmortem: root cause likely race in multiplexer retry logic introduced in recent deploy. Mitigation: add idempotent checks and a short-term rate-limit/atomic write on ingest-side. Also will add unit/integration test to avoid regressions.

deploy-bot: rollback completed successfully at 1821510605. No service degradation observed during rollback. :white_check_mark:

maya (oncall): final note before handoff — make sure billing holds are recorded in both Billing UI and the internal ledger (ledger flag: manual_hold=true). Carmen confirm done?

carmen (billing-ops): done. ledger flagged and finance notified. Sending summary to finance-ops@redwood.com.

lia (support): customer updated with provisional timeline and expected credit. they replied: "thanks — please keep us posted, we rely on accurate billing for our procurement." I'll escalate to AM for follow-up.

maya (oncall): closing on-call thread, moving to follow-up. I'll add a quick summary to the incidents page and create a runbook entry for tenant isolation during metering anomalies.

brian (sre): saving logs and will attach RCA draft later in INC-1821509999. Anything else immediate?

ops-eng: monitoring prod for 2h. So far stable. :eyes:

inc-bot: Incident INC-1821509999 status -> mitigated. Postmortem owner: brian (sre). Billing ticket: BILL-4718 (carmen). Customer comms: lia. Handoff complete.

maya (oncall): thanks all — nice work. :clap:"
